To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the feature selection algorithm can be applied to the analysis of stock market; 2) the most important factors of the stock market are: the price change rate, the trading volume, the trading volume rate, the price change rate in the last trading period and the trading volume rate in the last period.

the feature selection algorithms, especially the sequential forward search algorithm, can be used to find out a subset of the technical indicators that can be used in the prediction of the stock market.

the most important factors to the stock price are: 1) the moving average of 50 days, 2) the moving average 100 days, 3) the moving average deviation of 50 days and 4) the moving average standard deviation of 100 days.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most important indicators to the stock market are the price, the volume, the MACD, the EMA and the RSI.
the feature selection algorithms are able to reduce the number of factors, but they are unable to find out the best combination of factors.
the feature selection algorithms can effectively remove irrelevant and redundant factors, and find out the most relevant and significant subset of technical indicators.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the stock market can be modeled by a small subset of indicators, which can be used to build the stock analysis model.
the stock market is not a random walk, and there are a number of technical factors that can predict the stock market trend.
the feature selection algorithms can help us to identify the most important subset of indicators to build the analysis models.
